Check a table against a schema

Source: R/zutable.R
conform.Rd

conform() returns x as a zutable of schema s when its columns match it, and otherwise raises a zutable_schema_error that lists every mismatch: a missing column, an extra one, another order, a column of the wrong type. NA in a not_null() field is a zutable_value_error. metadata() returns a table's own key-value pairs.

Usage

conform(x, s)

metadata(x)

Arguments

x

A zutable or a data frame.

s

A schema from schema().

Value

conform() a zutable; metadata() a named character vector.

Examples

conform(data.frame(id = 1:2), schema(id = not_null(int32)))
#> <zutable> 2 rows x 1 column
#>   id
#>   <not_null(int32)>
#> 1 1
#> 2 2
